responsibility: Defines a standard general-purpose user exception family for ISO Modula-2 programs, with a small enumeration of generic conditions and helpers to raise and query them. It supplies a ready-made exception source layered on EXCEPTIONS for code that needs simple problem/disaster style exceptions without defining a custom source.
same_name_distinction: This .def file declares the standard GeneralExceptions enumeration and the public helper procedures for that exception family, while leaving the backing EXCEPTIONS source allocation and decoding logic to GeneralUserExceptions.mod.
